lessons.title: Connecting a Bank Account

steps.title: Start connection
steps.instruction: Click Link account in the Banking area.

feedback.correct: The bank search panel is open.
feedback.incorrect: Click Link account in the upper right of Banking.

steps.title: Search for the bank
steps.instruction: Type Citywide Bank into the bank search field.

feedback.incorrect: Enter Citywide Bank in the search field.

steps.title: Connect account
steps.instruction: Click Connect checking to complete the simulated connection.

quiz.question: Why connect a bank account to QuickBooks?
quiz.explanation: Bank feeds bring transactions into QuickBooks so you can match, categorize, and reconcile them.

lessons.completionMessage: You connected a simulated bank feed.

lessons.title: Reviewing Transactions

feedback.incorrect: Click the For review tab in Banking.

steps.title: Select transaction
steps.instruction: Click the Office Supply Co transaction row.

feedback.incorrect: Click the Office Supply Co row.

steps.title: Accept transaction
steps.instruction: Click Accept to add the reviewed transaction.

feedback.incorrect: Click Accept on the transaction detail.

quiz.question: What should you do before accepting a bank feed transaction?
quiz.explanation: Reviewing details prevents transactions from posting to the wrong accounts.

lessons.completionMessage: You reviewed and accepted a bank-feed transaction.

lessons.title: Bank Reconciliation

feedback.incorrect: Click Start reconciling on the Checking account.
Enter 12840.50 in the ending balance field.

steps.title: Finish reconciliation
steps.instruction: Click Finish now after the difference reaches zero.

feedback.incorrect: Click Finish now once the difference is zero.

quiz.question: What is the goal of bank reconciliation?
options: Match the books to the bank statement
quiz.correctAnswer: Match the books to the bank statement
quiz.explanation: Reconciliation confirms that recorded transactions agree with the bank statement.

lessons.completionMessage: You completed a simulated bank reconciliation.

lessons.title: Matching Transactions

steps.title: Find a match
steps.instruction: Click Find match on the Acme Corp deposit.

feedback.incorrect: Click Find match on the Acme Corp deposit row.

steps.title: Select the invoice
steps.instruction: Choose invoice qb-inv-1001 as the match.

feedback.incorrect: Choose qb-inv-1001 from the match list.

steps.title: Confirm match
steps.instruction: Click Match to connect the bank deposit to the invoice.

feedback.incorrect: Click Match after selecting the invoice.

quiz.question: Why match a bank deposit to an invoice instead of adding it as new income?
quiz.explanation: Matching links the bank line to an existing record, preventing duplicate income.

lessons.completionMessage: You matched a bank deposit to an existing invoice.
